# ClassicForum Project Guide

- **Architecture and code boundaries:** Start with [docs/Architecture.md](../docs/Architecture.md).
- **Plans and existing work:** Use [docs/Roadmap.md](../docs/Roadmap.md) and [docs/tickets/](../docs/tickets/). Check the relevant active, backlog, or completed ticket before changing related behavior.
- **Ticket format:** Read the [ticket template](../docs/tickets/_template.md) before creating or editing a ticket. Keep template guidance and placeholders out of real tickets.
- **Programming work:** Follow the [programming skill](skills/programming/SKILL.md).
- **Documentation:** Update relevant docs when a change intentionally affects architecture, operations, setup, or ticket scope.
